Relevant Regulatory Basis: Section 1.3 of the FIC Act (Fair and Integrated Compliance) as outlined in Public Compliance Communication 51_Guidance on measures relating to foreign prominent public official, domestic prominent influential persons, their immediate family members and known close associates Page 4 of 18 from December 2021.

3. Explanation: The FIC Act mandates enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons (PEPs) to mitigate the risk that they may misuse their influence in office, which could lead to corruption and money laundering activities as stated on page 1 of Source 1.
